meta.note: Common Paladin macros adapted to WoW Forever's changes (Judgement no longer eats the Seal; Seal of Fury Judgement = taunt; Holy Strike baseline). Written for the Classic-era macro API: [@mouseover], [help]/[harm], [nodead], [mod:shift], /startattack, /stopcasting, /castsequence and 'Spell(Rank N)' all work. Max 255 characters per macro.

conventions.mouseoverFallback: [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] = heal whatever is under the cursor (raid frames), else your friendly target, else yourself.
conventions.modifierRanks: Shift = downranked/cheap version of the same button, so the key keeps one meaning across specs.
conventions.verify: Items marked verify:true depend on behaviour not yet confirmed in the live Forever client.
conventions.covers: covers = other spells/actions this macro also fires (counted as bound for coverage).

macros.name: Mouseover Flash of Light
macros.body:
#showtooltip Flash of Light
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Flash of Light
macros.why: Core healer button. Works for off-spec emergency heals with no target swap.

macros.name: Mouseover Holy Light (shift = downrank)
macros.body:
#showtooltip Holy Light
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Holy Light(Rank 5); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Holy Light
macros.why: Downranking is the classic Holy Paladin mana tool. Adjust the rank number to taste.

macros.name: Smart Holy Shock (heal friend / hit enemy)
macros.why: One key for both Holy Shock modes; matters for Shockadin and Light's Vigil combos.

macros.name: Mouseover Light's Vigil
macros.why: Pre-place Vigils on one member of each party, then chain Holy Shocks on them for raid-wide healing.

macros.name: Oath of Light on focus-or-mouseover
macros.body:
#showtooltip Oath of Light
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help] Oath of Light
macros.why: Swear the Oath on the tank. @targettarget lets you target the boss and still hit the tank.

macros.name: Divine Favor + Holy Light
macros.body:
#showtooltip Divine Favor
/cast Divine Favor
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Holy Light
macros.why: Guaranteed crit big heal in one press. Only works if Divine Favor is off the global cooldown, as it is in Classic Era; otherwise press twice.

macros.name: Mouseover Cleanse
macros.why: Below level 42 use Purify in the same macro / same key.

macros.name: Stopcast + Flash of Light (snipe)
macros.body:
#showtooltip Flash of Light
/stopcasting
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Flash of Light
macros.why: Cancels a Holy Light in progress to react quickly. Keep it on a separate key from the plain FoL.

macros.name: Healer Judgement (shift = re-seal Wisdom)
macros.why: Judgement no longer consumes the Seal in Forever, so keeping Judgement of Wisdom up is one button + an occasional reseal.

macros.name: Lay on Hands (shift = self)
macros.body:
#showtooltip Lay on Hands
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Lay on Hands

macros.name: Holy Strike + auto attack
macros.why: Primary melee button for all specs; guarantees auto-attack is on.

macros.name: Hammer of the Righteous + auto attack
macros.body:
#showtooltip Hammer of the Righteous
/startattack
/cast Hammer of the Righteous
macros.why: Level 40 AoE strike (client data). Verify it is trainable in live.

macros.name: Tank Judgement / taunt (mouseover)
macros.why: With Seal of Fury active this is the 10-yd taunt. Mouseover lets you taunt a loose add without dropping your target.

macros.name: Swift Judgement (backup taunt, mouseover)
macros.why: Second Judgement on its own cooldown; covers a resisted taunt.

macros.name: Main Seal (spec-aware by modifier)
macros.body:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Wisdom; [mod:ctrl] Seal of Light; Seal of Fury
macros.why: Template: one 'Seal' key that you edit per spec (Prot: Fury, Ret: Command, Holy: Wisdom). Same key, same meaning — 'put my seal up'.

macros.name: Ret seal swap (Unsealed Wrath)
macros.body:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Seal of Righteousness; Seal of Command
macros.why: Unsealed Wrath stores up to 3 copies of your active Seal; swapping Seals cashes them in. Two seals on one key makes the swap a single finger.

macros.name: Defensive stack (Bulwark / Shield / Protection)
macros.why: Prot edits this to: /cast [mod:shift] Divine Shield; Templar's Bulwark. All three share Forbearance, so keep them on one key + modifiers.

macros.name: Stoneform
macros.why: Self-cleanse of poison/disease/bleed + 10% physical reduction.

macros.name: Mouseover Hammer of Justice
macros.why: Paladins have no interrupt; HoJ is the stop-the-cast button.

macros.name: Healthstone (shift = potion)
macros.why: Edit item names to whatever you carry at your level.

macros.name: Smart Blessing (Greater with shift)
macros.body:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift] Greater Blessing of Kings; Blessing of Kings
macros.why: Out-of-combat buff key. Swap Kings for Might/Wisdom as your raid assignment requires.

macros.name: Cancel Salvation (tanks)
macros.why: Only relevant if Salvation/Mass Salvation exist live (Blizzard announced them; current client data doesn't list them).
